read.thesis: Capital One Q4 CY25: credit settling after a year of improvement (domestic card charge-off 4.93%, down 113bp YoY), but opex up 13% QoQ and near-term efficiency pressure from investments and the $5.15B Brex deal.

capex.peers_comment: Management said the biggest players in premium cards are leaning even harder into it and investing, so Capital One is doing so as well.
capex.quote: it's very clear that the biggest players in that space are leaning even harder into that. And they're investing.

triggers.label: Opex up 13% QoQ
triggers.quote: Noninterest expense rose 13% sequentially from Q3

triggers.label: NIM 8.26%, down 10bp QoQ
triggers.quote: Our fourth quarter net interest margin was 8.26%, 10 basis points lower than the prior quarter.

triggers.label: Card delinquency 3.99%, seasonal
triggers.quote: On a sequential quarter basis, both our charge-offs and delinquencies moved in line with normal seasonality.

triggers.label: Efficiency ratio up near term
triggers.quote: The net effect will be some upward pressure on efficiency ratio in the near term.

guidance.metric: Long-term earnings power post Discover integration
guidance.value: consistent with Discover deal expectations, inclusive of Brex
guidance.quote: we still expect our earnings power on the other side of the Discover integration to be consistent with what we expected

guidance.value: upward pressure in near term; no specific efficiency guidance
guidance.quote: some upward pressure on efficiency ratio in the near term

guidance.value: $14B remaining authorization; Brex not changing buyback pace
guidance.quote: We've got $14 billion of remaining authorization

red_flags.label: Efficiency ratio pressure and Brex dilution
red_flags.quote: in isolation, Brex will result in earnings dilution initially.

red_flags.label: Proposed credit card rate cap risk
red_flags.quote: would make credit much less available for consumers

evasions.topic: Brex financial metrics (tangible book dilution, accretion)
evasions.quote: Given the relative size of Brex to Capital One Financial Corporation, we don't intend to provide additional metrics.

evasions.topic: Small business card and travel portal sizing
evasions.quote: those just aren't metrics that we break out in our reporting
